overview.en:
Search, read and organize Drive files through Google’s official Workspace MCP service.

Locate files and review their contents in the connected workspace. Keep file identity and access context explicit when preparing a summary or organization plan.

This connection requires Google Workspace Developer Preview access, a configured Google Cloud project, and your own OAuth application. Complete that setup in Ghast before requesting account data or edits.
overview.zh-CN:
通过 Google 官方 Workspace MCP 服务检索、阅读与整理云端硬盘文件。

在已连接工作区中定位文件并查看内容，准备摘要或整理方案时明确文件身份与访问范围。

此连接需要 Google Workspace Developer Preview 访问权限、已配置的 Google Cloud 项目和自有 OAuth 应用。请先在 Ghast 中完成配置，再请求账号数据或编辑操作。

starterPrompts.en: Find the files for this project and summarize what each contains.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 查找这个项目的文件，并汇总各文件内容。

starterPrompts.en: Compare these two documents and list the substantive differences.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 比较这两份文档，列出实质性差异。

starterPrompts.en: Prepare a file organization plan for this project without moving files yet.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 为这个项目准备文件整理方案，先不要移动文件。

descriptions.en: Use Google Drive in Ghast. Search, read and organize Drive files through Google’s official Workspace MCP service. 通过 Google 官方 Workspace MCP 服务检索、阅读与整理云端硬盘文件。
